decisions_made.reason: Centralized stageKey resolution in src/lib/wedding-timeline.ts provides consistent name ordering (primaryCoupleName, shortCoupleName, uppercaseCoupleName, initials) and bank account filtering across both client components and server metadata.
In accordance with wedding customs, during Lễ Vu Quy (Nhà Gái) only the bride's banking QR card is presented, while during Lễ Thành Hôn (Nhà Trai) both accounts are displayed.
